name: France
intro: Explore France through riverfront cities, Mediterranean ports, regional food traditions and historic neighbourhoods.
season: Festival programmes vary by season and year; check dates before planning around a particular event. Keep a weather alternative for outdoor sightseeing.
transport: Check the exact departure and arrival stations: SNCF Connect can suggest alternative stations around your chosen city. Allow time for transfers across Paris when your journey changes stations.

cities.name: Paris
cities.description: Paris combines Seine-side landmarks with major art collections and distinctive neighbourhoods.

cities.name: Lyon
cities.description: Lyon brings together Renaissance streets, silk-working heritage and traditional bouchon restaurants.

cities.name: Marseille
cities.description: Marseille centres its Mediterranean maritime identity on a working harbour and hillside neighbourhoods.

cities.name: Nice
cities.description: Nice pairs a Mediterranean seafront promenade with the narrow streets and markets of its old town.

cities.name: Bordeaux
cities.description: Bordeaux combines grand stone architecture along the Garonne with a strong wine culture.

cities.name: Strasbourg
cities.description: Strasbourg blends Alsatian timber-framed streets, canals and a monumental Gothic cathedral.

cities.name: Toulouse
cities.description: Toulouse's pink-brick historic centre links grand civic architecture with Romanesque religious heritage.

cities.name: Lille
cities.description: Lille combines Flemish-influenced architecture with lively squares and the brick streets of its old town.

cities.name: Nantes
cities.description: Nantes turns its Loire-side industrial heritage into a setting for public art and mechanical creatures.

cities.name: Dijon
cities.description: Dijon preserves the architectural legacy of Burgundy's dukes in a compact historic centre.
sights: Palace of the Dukes of Burgundy

name: United Kingdom
intro: Discover England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland through historic cities, maritime districts, museums and music.
season: Christmas and New Year rail journeys can be affected by planned engineering works; check your specific travel dates. Keep an indoor option for changeable weather.
transport: National Rail covers Great Britain; use Translink for Northern Ireland journeys, including Belfast. Belfast is not connected to Great Britain by a direct rail route.

cities.name: London
cities.description: London combines royal history and major museums with West End theatre and varied neighbourhoods.

cities.name: Edinburgh
cities.description: Edinburgh contrasts the medieval lanes of its Old Town with the Georgian streets of its New Town.

cities.name: Glasgow
cities.description: Glasgow combines Victorian civic architecture with major art collections and a lively music scene.

cities.name: Manchester
cities.description: Manchester's industrial heritage shapes a city known for football, music and creative neighbourhoods.

cities.name: Liverpool
cities.description: Liverpool connects its maritime waterfront with the musical legacy of the Beatles.

cities.name: York
cities.description: York layers Roman and Viking history within medieval walls and narrow historic streets.

cities.name: Bath
cities.description: Bath brings Roman bathing heritage and sweeping Georgian architecture together in a compact city.

cities.name: Bristol
cities.description: Bristol combines a historic harbour with engineering landmarks and a strong street-art culture.

cities.name: Cardiff
cities.description: Cardiff pairs a central castle and Victorian shopping arcades with a redeveloped waterfront.

cities.name: Belfast
cities.description: Belfast links its shipbuilding heritage with Victorian landmarks and the cultural venues of the Cathedral Quarter.

name: Belgium
intro: Belgium connects Flemish art cities, Brussels neighbourhoods and Walloon heritage centres within a compact country.
season: Bruges canal cruises depend on seasonal schedules, weather and demand; confirm operation for your visit. Museum-led breaks offer an alternative to outdoor plans.
transport: Bruxelles-Midi and Brussel-Zuid name the same station; recognise both names when planning Brussels connections. Check local transit separately from your national rail ticket.

cities.name: Brussels
cities.description: Brussels combines ornate guildhall architecture with Art Nouveau heritage and European institutions.

cities.name: Bruges
cities.description: Bruges preserves a medieval streetscape of canals, stepped-gable houses and historic squares.

cities.name: Ghent
cities.description: Ghent combines medieval towers and canal-side guildhouses with the energy of a university city.

cities.name: Antwerp
cities.description: Antwerp brings together a major port's trading heritage, Flemish art and contemporary fashion.

cities.name: Leuven
cities.description: Leuven's university heritage shapes a compact centre of historic colleges, squares and cafés.

cities.name: Mechelen
cities.description: Mechelen combines a cathedral-dominated skyline with historic palaces and streets along the River Dyle.

cities.name: Liège
cities.description: Liège spreads along the Meuse beneath steep historic hillsides and monumental stairways.

cities.name: Namur
cities.description: Namur sits beneath a hillside citadel where the Sambre and Meuse rivers meet.

cities.name: Mons
cities.description: Mons combines a historic central square with a distinctive Baroque belfry and a strong cultural tradition.

cities.name: Tournai
cities.description: Tournai's skyline is defined by its five-towered cathedral and Belgium's oldest belfry.

name: Norway
intro: Norway combines fjord-facing cities, wooden historic quarters and Arctic cultural centres.
season: Daylight varies sharply by latitude: Tromsø experiences midnight sun in summer and polar night in winter. Plan outdoor time around your destination and actual travel dates.
transport: Rail does not reach Tromsø; plan northern journeys with connecting buses, boats or flights, using Entur to check public transport connections.

cities.name: Oslo
cities.description: Norway's capital combines contemporary waterfront architecture with museums and outdoor sculpture.

cities.name: Bergen
cities.description: Bergen's historic trading waterfront sits between mountain slopes and Norway's western fjords.

cities.name: Tromsø
cities.description: Tromsø pairs Arctic exploration history with a lively city centre surrounded by mountains and fjords.

cities.name: Trondheim
cities.description: Trondheim brings together medieval pilgrimage heritage and colourful wooden neighbourhoods along the Nidelva.

cities.name: Stavanger
cities.description: Stavanger combines preserved wooden streets with museums exploring Norway's offshore oil industry.

cities.name: Ålesund
cities.description: Ålesund's Art Nouveau streets spread across coastal islands beneath the Aksla viewpoint.

cities.name: Bodø
cities.description: Bodø combines northern coastal culture with aviation history and access to powerful tidal currents nearby.

cities.name: Kristiansand
cities.description: Kristiansand pairs southern Norway's seaside atmosphere with a historic quarter of white wooden houses.

cities.name: Lillehammer
cities.description: Lillehammer combines traditional Norwegian buildings with the sporting legacy of the 1994 Winter Olympics.

cities.name: Fredrikstad
cities.description: Fredrikstad's fortified old town preserves cobbled streets and historic buildings beside the Glomma.

name: Austria
intro: Austria links imperial architecture, musical heritage and contemporary culture with Alpine city settings.
season: Mountain opening dates depend on altitude and weather. Check individual huts, lifts and attractions before adding an Alpine excursion to your city break.
transport: Austria's main cities connect by rail, but mountain excursions can require onward buses or cable cars; check the complete journey and return connection in ÖBB SCOTTY.

cities.name: Vienna
cities.description: Vienna combines Habsburg palaces, major art collections and a long-established coffeehouse culture.

cities.name: Salzburg
cities.description: Salzburg's baroque old town and hilltop fortress frame a city closely associated with Mozart.

cities.name: Innsbruck
cities.description: Innsbruck places an imperial old town directly beneath the rugged Nordkette mountain range.

cities.name: Graz
cities.description: Graz combines a historic roofscape with striking contemporary architecture beside the Mur.

cities.name: Linz
cities.description: Linz connects its Danube setting with digital art and contemporary museum architecture.

cities.name: Klagenfurt
cities.description: Klagenfurt combines a historic city centre with access to Lake Wörthersee.

cities.name: Bregenz
cities.description: Bregenz combines Lake Constance scenery with contemporary art and a historic upper town.

cities.name: Eisenstadt
cities.description: Eisenstadt's palaces and musical landmarks reflect Joseph Haydn's association with the Esterházy court.

cities.name: St. Pölten
cities.description: St. Pölten contrasts a baroque civic centre with modern cultural buildings in Lower Austria's capital.

cities.name: Villach
cities.description: Villach combines colourful old-town streets with riverside walks and cycle routes along the Drau.

name: Switzerland
intro: Switzerland combines lakeside cities, medieval centres and distinctive German-, French- and Italian-speaking regions.
season: Scenic transport services have route-specific operating calendars; check boat and mountain connections for your exact travel date.
transport: Use SBB for connected rail, bus and boat journeys, and check panoramic trains separately for service-specific seat reservations.

cities.name: Zurich
cities.description: Zurich combines medieval lanes along the Limmat with lakeside promenades and major art museums.

cities.name: Geneva
cities.description: Geneva brings together international institutions, a hillside old town and Lake Geneva's waterfront.

cities.name: Basel
cities.description: Basel pairs a medieval Rhine-side centre with a concentration of art museums.

cities.name: Bern
cities.description: Bern's arcaded old town occupies a peninsula enclosed by a bend in the Aare.

cities.name: Lucerne
cities.description: Lucerne combines covered wooden bridges and painted old-town façades beside its Alpine lake.

cities.name: Lausanne
cities.description: Lausanne rises from Lake Geneva through steep streets to a Gothic cathedral and historic centre.

cities.name: Lugano
cities.description: Lugano combines Italian-speaking Swiss culture with lakeside gardens and mountain viewpoints.

cities.name: St. Gallen
cities.description: St. Gallen centres on an abbey district renowned for its baroque library and religious architecture.

cities.name: Chur
cities.description: Chur's winding old-town streets sit beneath Alpine slopes at a gateway to Graubünden.

cities.name: Winterthur
cities.description: Winterthur combines a pedestrian old town with art collections and Switzerland's hands-on science centre.
